fdroid:app.nasmanager.name: NasManager
fdroid:app.nasmanager.summary: Unofficial companion client for TrueNAS SCALE: dashboard, graphs, alerts, apps
fdroid:app.nasmanager.description:
NasManager is an unofficial companion client for TrueNAS® SCALE servers. It talks directly to your server over its WebSocket JSON-RPC API (/api/current): no account to create, no intermediate server, no tracking, no ads.
 Dashboard 
 System information, CPU (total and per core), memory (Services / ZFS Cache / Free, same breakdown as the TrueNAS web dashboard), pools and storage
 CPU, memory and pools refreshed every 2 seconds
 Reporting graphs 
 CPU: usage (average and per core), temperature, load average
 Memory: available, used, ZFS cache (ARC)
 Time range from 5 minutes to 1 month, optional auto-refresh every 5 seconds
 Pools: space breakdown, topology, usable capacity, status, fragmentation, last scrub
 Per-disk detail: I/O and temperature graphs, with max / mean / min
 Alerts : list of active alerts with a badge in the menu, and a "Dismiss" button per alert (applied on the server, like in the web interface).
 Apps : installed apps with their status, start or stop an app, update one app or all of them at once.
 System : general settings, network configuration and interfaces, boot environments (read-only), and services (SMB, NFS, SSH…) you can start, stop or set to start automatically.
 Power : restart or shut down the server from the menu, after a confirmation (requires a full admin account).
 Security and privacy — please read 
 Authentication : the app logs in once per connection (auth.login_ex) with your username and password, or an API key pasted in the password field (HTTPS only). Use a TrueNAS account dedicated to the app with reduced permissions, rather than your main admin account.
 Reverse proxy : behind an authenticating proxy, enter its Basic auth credentials (Pangolin header auth, nginx, Traefik, Caddy, Authelia…) or a Cloudflare Access service token. HTTPS only; browser-based SSO logins are not supported.
 Unencrypted HTTP : HTTPS is recommended. Plain HTTP (IP address or hostname) is possible, but only after you explicitly check a box accepting the risk: your credentials then travel in clear text on the network.
 Credential storage : by default, credentials are only kept in memory. If you check "Stay logged in", they are saved on the device, encrypted with AES-GCM using a key held in the Android Keystore. "Stay logged in" is unavailable for an HTTP address, so a saved password is never sent automatically in clear text.
 Network connections : the app only connects to the server address you enter, plus, on the Apps screen, the public TrueNAS icon CDN (media.sys.truenas.net) to display app icons. Your credentials are never sent to that CDN.
 Requirements and limits 
 TrueNAS SCALE 25.04 or later (tested on 25.10), reachable from your phone. With a self-signed certificate (TrueNAS default), install it in Android's security settings for HTTPS to work.
 No per-app CPU / memory / network usage: TrueNAS only exposes these metrics as live subscription events, which the app doesn't use.
 "Discover Apps" (catalog browsing and install) is not available yet.
 Interface in English.
Free software, GPLv3 licensed.
TrueNAS® is a registered trademark of iXsystems, Inc. This app is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by iXsystems.

Flux News: High-Performance Miniflux Client
Elevate your reading experience. Flux News is a fast, fluid, and deeply integrated newsreader designed specifically for the Miniflux backend. Built to outperform standard web interfaces, it provides a seamless workflow that keeps your content accessible, even when you're offline.
Master Your Feed with Ease
 • Offline-Ready: Unlike a browser, Flux News stores your articles locally. Sync your feeds once and read them anywhere, on the plane, in the subway, or in remote areas without an internet connection.
 • Intuitive Gesture Control: Navigate your news with natural swipe gestures. Quickly triage your articles, mark them as read, or save them for later with a simple flick of your finger.
 • Effortless "Scroll-to-Read": Experience a friction-free "inbox zero" workflow. Articles are automatically marked as read as you scroll over them, so you never have to manually clear your queue again.
 • Deep System Integration: Share interesting finds instantly using the System Share Sheet or send articles directly to your configured third-party services.
 • Direct App Linking: Open articles directly in their respective installed apps for a cohesive experience that feels right at home on your device.
Podcast Excellence
 • Integrated Player: High-performance playback with variable speed control.
 • Smart Management: Automatic download of new episodes and automatic deletion after listening to save space.
 • Advanced Audio Features: Full chapter recognition for easy navigation and a built-in sleep timer.
 • Backend Sync: Your playback progress is synchronized with Miniflux, so you never lose your spot.
 • Dedicated Downloads View: Manage all your offline audio content in one place.
On the Road
 • CarPlay: A safe, audio-centric interface for your vehicle's dashboard.
 • Seamless Integration: Access your downloaded podcasts and control playback safely while driving.
Tailored for Your Device
 • OLED-Optimized Design: Choose between Light, Dark, and a specialized True Black mode designed specifically to save battery and look stunning on high-end displays.
 • Precision Filtering & Search: Instantly sort through your content by status (Unread, Read, Starred), category, or individual feeds. Use the powerful search to query your entire Miniflux backend in seconds.
 • Quick Access to Discussions: Open article comments directly within the app to stay on top of the conversation.
 • Home Screen Widgets: Access your articles directly from your device's home screen with the new native widgets.
 • Background Sync: The app now can automatically synchronizes in the background, keeping your news updated with your Miniflux server.
Privacy by Design
Your data belongs to you. Flux News acts as a transparent window to your own server.
 • Direct Sync: The app communicates directly with your Miniflux API.
 • No Third-Party Tracking: We do not collect, store, or analyze your reading habits.
 • No Middlemen: Your credentials and content never pass through any external servers other than your own.
Please Note: This app requires an existing Miniflux server instance or a Miniflux Cloud account.

fdroid:tech.dongdongbh.mindwtr.name: Mindwtr - GTD Task Manager
fdroid:tech.dongdongbh.mindwtr.summary: Clear your head: capture tasks fast, see your next step. Offline, free, GTD.
fdroid:tech.dongdongbh.mindwtr.description:
Your head keeps reminding you of things at the worst times. Mindwtr gives them a safe home.
Mindwtr (pronounced "mind water") is a free, open-source to-do app built on the Getting Things Done (GTD) method. Write down every task and idea the moment it appears, sort it in seconds, and see only what you can do right now. No account, no subscription, and your data stays on your device.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Dump it. A task, an idea, a worry: type it or speak it, and it lands in your Inbox.
2. Sort it. A short guided pass: do it now, schedule it, hand it off, or shelve it for someday.
3. Do it. The Focus view shows only what you can act on right now, nothing else.
4. Reset weekly. A guided review catches loose ends, so the list stays trustworthy and your head stays clear.
New to GTD? The idea is simple: your head is for having ideas, not for holding them. Mindwtr walks you through every step.
WHY MINDWTR
- Works completely offline. No account required.
- Your tasks stay on your device. Sync is optional and you choose where: Dropbox, a folder you control, WebDAV, your own server, or iCloud on Apple devices.
- The full GTD method built in: Inbox, Next, Waiting For, Someday/Maybe, Projects, Areas, Contexts, and reviews.
- Capture from anywhere: quick add, widgets, sharing from other apps, or voice.
- Plan your way: list, calendar, and kanban board views.
- Reminders, repeating tasks, checklists, Markdown notes, and attachments.
- Import from Todoist, TickTick, OmniFocus, and more.
- Free and open source. No ads or lock-in.
SIMPLE BY DEFAULT, POWERFUL WHEN YOU NEED IT
Fewer fields, fewer knobs, no clutter. Advanced tools, like the kanban board, automation, and an optional AI assistant that uses your own AI account, stay out of sight until you want them.
Mindwtr means "mind like water": the calm you get when nothing is rattling around in your head.

It has been originally designed to perform comparison between two 3D points clouds (such as the ones obtained with a laser scanner) or between a point cloud and a triangular mesh. It was also meant to deal with huge point clouds (typically more than 10 millions points, and up to 120 millions with 2 Gb of memory). fedora-packages:folly/folly.description: Folly (acronymed loosely after Facebook Open Source Library) is a library of C++14 components designed with practicality and efficiency in mind. Folly contains a variety of core library components used extensively at Facebook. In particular, it's often a dependency of Facebook's other open source C++ efforts and place where those projects can share code. It complements (as opposed to competing against) offerings such as Boost and of course std. In fact, we embark on defining our own component only when something we need is either not available, or does not meet the needed performance profile. We endeavor to remove things from folly if or when std or Boost obsoletes them. Performance concerns permeate much of Folly, sometimes leading to designs that are more idiosyncratic than they would otherwise be (see e.g. PackedSyncPtr.h, SmallLocks.h). Good performance at large scale is a unifying theme in all of Folly.

firefox-addons:308561.name: Bitdefender TrafficLight for Firefox
firefox-addons:308561.summary: Bitdefender TrafficLight adds a strong and non-intrusive layer of security to your browsing experience
firefox-addons:308561.description:
TrafficLight is taking the security-while-browsing concept where it belongs: in the browser. This extension will add a strong layer of security over your browsing experience without inducing speed penalties or system resource consumption. Part of the processing is done in the cloud with some intelligent small engines that make various checks on pages you're visiting enabling you to have top notch antiphishing and antimalware protection.
Features:
Real Time: TrafficLight scans the pages you visit for malware and phishing attempts each and every time you access them to avoid the threat of legitimate but recently compromised websites.
Precise: TrafficLight won't block an entire website if just some pages within are malicious. Only the potentially harmful elements are blocked, leaving you free to view the rest of the site if you so choose.
Unintrusive: TrafficLight does not add a toolbar to your already-cluttered browser interface. Its interface remains invisible until your input is needed or it's called up with a simple mouse gesture.
Search Results: TrafficLight flags malware and fraudulent websites in search results.

firefox-addons:2224030.description:
## Speed Translate
### Translates texts quickly.
This extensions allows you to translate the text selection using Google Translate whenever you want.
* Supports over 50 languages
* When the extension is installed select some text from a website, then press "shift" button to show translation.

- If there were opened tabs before you install the extension, you must refresh those tabs in order to activate extension.

firefox-addons:3131747.summary: Fill in and copy Omni Password passwords without leaving the page. End-to-end encrypted, with automatic lock.
firefox-addons:3131747.description:
Omni Password is the browser extension for Password, the password manager in the Omniquantics suite. It brings the logins from your company’s vault to the page you are on, without opening another tab.
You need an Omniquantics account with the Password app, and your company’s vault must use end-to-end encryption (activate your own end-to-end vault in Password: master password and Secret Key). The extension does not work without them.
WHAT IT DOES
• Shows the logins from your vault that match the site you are on (title and username only).
• Fills in the username and password only when you click Fill, and only if the page address matches the one saved in the item. Press Ctrl+Shift+L (Command+Shift+L on a Mac) to open the extension, then click Fill.
• Copies a password with one click. About 90 seconds later, the extension overwrites the clipboard.
• Searches your whole vault by title or username.
• Offers to save a new login after you sign in to a site you have allowed. Until you click Save, the login stays only in the extension’s memory for up to 2 minutes, and you choose the vault.
• Locks itself after 10 minutes without use, after 12 hours, when your computer locks, when your Password session ends, or when you click Lock now.
PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• End-to-end encrypted: your master password and Secret Key stay on your device. Passwords are decrypted only inside the extension, in memory, and the Omniquantics server stores only encrypted data. The server never sees your passwords.
• It never fills in on its own: nothing is filled in when a page loads.
• You decide where it acts: without permission, the extension only acts when you click it. In the options, you allow sites one by one.
• No ads, no usage analytics, no trackers and no remote code. Everything runs from the extension package.
• The decrypted keys live only in the extension’s memory and are gone when it locks.
GETTING STARTED
1. Sign in to Password in this browser ( password.omniquantics.com ).
2. In Firefox, connect this browser to Password once: in Password, open Browser extension > Connected browsers > Connect this Firefox and type the code it shows into the extension (valid for 5 minutes, single use). Both screens show the same key fingerprint.
3. Click the extension icon, choose your company and type your master password. The first time in this browser it also asks for your Secret Key, which is in your Emergency Kit.
4. Open a site’s sign-in page, click the icon, then click Fill.
Available in 14 languages: it follows your browser’s language. Requires Firefox 143 or later.

Support: https://omniquantics.com
